symbols.name: first input sequence
symbols.meaning: The first of the two sequences, of length s.
symbols.quote: Let $f = (f_0, \dots, f_{s-1})$ and $g = (g_0, \dots, g_{s-1})$ be two sequences of the same length $s$.

symbols.name: second input sequence
symbols.meaning: The second of the two sequences, of length s.
symbols.quote: Let $f = (f_0, \dots, f_{s-1})$ and $g = (g_0, \dots, g_{s-1})$ be two sequences of the same length $s$.

symbols.name: formal variable
symbols.meaning: A formal variable in which a sequence is written as a polynomial, never evaluated.
symbols.quote: Identify $f$ with the polynomial $f(w) = \sum_{j=0}^{s-1} f_j w^j$, where $w$ is a formal variable.
